title: Local linear tests detect sections of free pro-affine etale completed modules
statement: Let l be prime, X a scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and U an object whose structure map is proAffineEtale [sk-def-pe-morphisms]. Let R be the completed coefficient ring, the limit of the constant ring sheaves Z/l^(n+1) [def-pur-twist-coefficient-rings], and P the module sheafification of the free R-presheaf on the universe-lifted representable of U [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For V and x in P(V), suppose that for every W, map f:W to V, and R|W-linear sheaf map phi:P|W to R|W, evaluation of phi on x restricted to W is zero. Then x=0. Restrictions and the unit module are the ordinary slice-site restrictions of module sheaves. There are no divisibility hypotheses or coefficient projection hypotheses.

source.place: paragraph (1), corrected finite-support local generator argument

proof.text: Lift x locally along the locally surjective sheafification unit. On the covering image sieve, a representative y has image equal to the restriction of x. If its sheafification image is zero, the restriction is zero. Otherwise apply the corrected presheaf local-dual lemma to get a slice functional nonzero on that image, contradicting the hypothesis on all local functionals. Sheaf separatedness descends the resulting vanishing to x=0. No injectivity of the free-presheaf sheafification unit is used.

proof_origin.note: Forced proof adaptation to the corrected nonzero-image hypothesis; the public theorem signature is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem completedAffineFree_localDual_detect (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (hU : proAffineEtale U.unop.hom) :
    let R := Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion X l)
    let P := (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 R.obj)).obj
      ((PresheafOfModules.free R.obj).obj (uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj U.unop))
    ∀ (V : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : P.val.obj V),
      (∀ (W : X.ProEt) (f : W ⟶ V.unop)
        (φ : P.over W ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit (R.over W)),
        φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))) (P.val.map f.op x) = 0) → x = 0
